items.title: Upgrades no longer tombstone your sessions
items.text: App updates used to sometimes bring every window back "exited". The updater now leaves your running agent and its live processes untouched during an upgrade, so your windows re-attach to the same running processes.

items.title: Exact repaint on re-attach
items.text: Reconnecting to a full-screen app (editors, `top`, anything using the alternate screen) no longer leaves the pane blank or smeared; panes restore their exact visible screen, with genuinely-evicted scrollback honestly marked.
